resources.string: Shows the card to review on the lock screen.

In the wallpaper settings:
1. Select the Lock screen preview (not Home screen). 2. Open the wallpaper list and choose Live wallpapers, then AnkiDroid Companion card. 3. When asked where to apply it, choose Lock screen only.
Your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.

On this Android version, a live wallpaper is applied to both the home and the lock screen. The card is only shown while the phone is locked; the home screen will show a plain dark background.
In the wallpaper settings, open Live wallpapers and choose AnkiDroid Companion card.
Permission to read AnkiDroid cards was not granted.
